[SWS_CM_99035] Subscription State change handler on the Proxy side
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00106
⌈
The handler
SubscriptionStateChangeHandler
defined in [SWS_CM_00311]
shall be called for the Proxy side by the Communication Management implementation
as soon as the subscription state of this event has changed. Handler may be overwrit-
ten during runtime.
